passes.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production diffuse/base-colour UV atlas for the StarLancer Cossack (native Kossac) fighter restoration.
Input image is the exact original 256x256 texture atlas, and is the edit target. Restore it as a high-resolution square atlas, preferably 2048x2048 or larger, with the same UV layout, identical framing and no margins.
Preserve EVERY feature's exact normalized position, outline, scale and orientation: all grey metal panel seams, paired round sockets, vents and radiator strips, red five-point stars and ochre edging, red paint bands, diagonal white/red stripes, yellow/black caution strips, switches, technical details, and amber cockpit glazing. Do not rearrange, crop, add or remove atlas islands. This image will wrap the original mesh unchanged.
Reconstruct the worn silver/medium-grey industrial hull with crisp engraved thin panel gaps, restrained rivets, fine chips, grime concentrated at seams and subtly varied grey plating. Match original overall palette and worn appearance; avoid bright white metal or excessive black dirt. Crisp straight radiator slats remain inside their original bounds.
Make all amber/brown window interiors smooth dark amber glass within the EXACT existing window apertures and frames. Remove the old mottled or crosshatched painted-in reflection pattern only inside these windows. Keep opaque legacy-style glass, no cockpit interior and no reflection streaks: runtime reflections will supply the highlights. Do not change any frame or introduce extra window geometry.
Flat neutral illumination suitable for PBR base colour, with no directional cast light, no lens effects, no rendered model, no labels, no border, no new text, no watermarks. This is a faithful detailed restoration of the supplied full atlas, not a redesign.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this full Cossack spacecraft texture atlas, preserving the exact image dimensions, pixel alignment, all panel lines, weathering, insignia, mechanical details and window frames.
Change ONLY the interiors of these FIVE amber cockpit panes: the large tall pane at x~515-620 y~160-306; smaller pane at x~515-620 y~332-388; broad pane at x~650-787 y~203-307; small angular pane at x~650-732 y~334-374; irregular pane at the far right x~1165-1253 y~320-438 (coordinates on this 1254px atlas).
Make the entire interior of every one of those panes a uniform deep dark amber-brown, opaque glass, with an almost imperceptible smooth gradient at most. Remove ALL the internal crossed lines, rectangular blocks, streaks, patches, reflections and mottling inside these panes. Keep each pane's ORIGINAL precise shape and existing metal border unchanged. These are single smooth glass panes, not divided windows, and runtime reflections will provide the highlights. No new highlight lines or strokes. Leave every other pixel of the full atlas alone. Full atlas, no crop, no margin, no remapping, no text.
